author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: The current drawing was a symmetric bottle shape with horizontal loops, identical to the plain bee, and it read as a vase or a robot. Its wings didn't droop. Redrawn after the honeybee reference: a round head with antennae, a slim domed body with two stripes and a pointed tail, and long wings hanging down and out from the shoulders to the lower sides.
omissions: The wings no longer overlap the body as in the reference; they hang beside it so every outline keeps 8 units.
